newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil eyes 20-year lira-denominated bond - Cenbank.
newsitem.headline: Brazil eyes 20-year lira-denominated bond - Cenbank.

text.p: Brazil mulls issuing between $200 million and $500 million in debt denominated in Italian lire some time this year, said a Central Bank official.

"We are considering the alternative to launch between $200 million and $500 million in 20-year lira-denominated bonds," Marcio Cartier, assistant to Central Bank International Affairs director Gustavo Franco, told Reuters.
Brazil's latest issue was a 1.0 billion 10-year mark bonds earlier this month.
The issue of lira-denominated bonds would be a continuation of seven launches in foreign currencies.

Central Bank International Affairs director Gustavo Franco has said that Brazil has been tapping foreign bond markets to extend the maturity of its debt and bring the country to the attention of international markets, but not for financing needs.
((-- Fatima Cristina, Rio de Janeiro Newsroom 5521 5074151))
